13728-marcella.description: A book by Mrs. Humphry Ward. sion of well-being and of dignity. Marcella drew it in--this impression--with avidity. Yet at the same moment she noticed involuntarily the gateless gap at the end of the avenue, the choked condition of the garden paths on either side of the lawn, and the unsightly tufts of grass spotting the broad gravel terrace beneath her window.

arxiv-1907-07047.description: Abstract Flat modules play an important role in the study of the category of modules over rings and in the characterization of some classes of rings. We study the e e -flatness for semimodules introduced by the first author using his new notion of exact sequences of semimodules and its relationships with other notions of flatness for semimodules over semirings.

arxiv-2104-14827.title: Joint Linear Trend Recovery Using ℓ 1 \ell_{1} Regularization
arxiv-2104-14827.creator: Xiaoli Gao Department of Mathematics and Statistics University of North Carolina at Greensboro Syed Ejaz Ahmed Department of Mathematics Brock University
arxiv-2104-14827.description: Abstract Abstract This paper studies the recovery of a joint piece-wise linear trend from a time series using \ell_{1} regularization approach, called \ell_{1} trend filtering (Kim, Koh and Boyd, 2009). We provide some sufficient conditions under which a \ell_{1} trend filter can be well-behaved in terms of mean estimation and change point detection.

arxiv-2107-14675.title: Signature Gröbner bases, bases of syzygies and cofactor reconstruction in the free algebra
arxiv-2107-14675.creator: Clemens Hofstadler, Thibaut Verron
arxiv-2107-14675.description: Abstract Signature-based algorithms have become a standard approach for computing Gröbner bases in commutative polynomial rings. However, so far, it was not clear how to extend this concept to the setting of noncommutative polynomials in the free algebra. In this paper, we present a signature-based algorithm for computing Gröbner bases in precisely this setting.

arxiv-2209-08121.title: The physics of intersecting thick to thin branes
arxiv-2209-08121.creator: 1 José L. Paulino, 1,2 Francisco A. Brito
arxiv-2209-08121.description: Abstract We model four-dimensional junctions made out of intersections of co-dimension one brane living in higher-dimensional spacetimes through domain walls. We take a new look at the problem of localizing fermion states on brane junctions as a result of intersecting one thick brane to others sufficiently thin.

arxiv-2303-17935.title: GelSight EndoFlex: A Soft Endoskeleton Hand with Continuous High-Resolution Tactile Sensing
arxiv-2303-17935.creator: Sandra Q. Liu ∗ , Leonardo Zamora Yañez ∗ , Edward H. Adelson
arxiv-2303-17935.description: Abstract We describe a novel three-finger robot hand that has high resolution tactile sensing along the entire length of each finger. The fingers are compliant, constructed with a soft shell supported with a flexible endoskeleton. Each finger contains two cameras, allowing tactile data to be gathered along the front and side surfaces of the fingers.

arxiv-2308-16698.title: Ultrafast transfer of low-mass payloads to Mars and beyond using aerographite solar sails
arxiv-2308-16698.creator: Julius Karlapp, René Heller, Martin Tajmar
arxiv-2308-16698.description: Abstract With interstellar mission concepts now being under study by various space agencies and institutions, a feasible and worthy interstellar precursor mission concept will be key to the success of the long shot. Here we investigate interstellar-bound trajectories of solar sails made of the ultra lightweight material aerographite. Due to its extremely low density ( 0.

arxiv-2312-09268.title: Hodge conjecture for projective hypersurfaces
arxiv-2312-09268.creator: Johann Bouali
arxiv-2312-09268.description: Abstract We show that a Hodge class of a complex smooth projective hypersurface is an analytic logarithmic De Rham class. On the other hand we show that for a complex smooth projective variety an analytic logarithmic De Rham class of type ( d , d ) (d,d) is the class of a codimension d d algebraic cycle.

arxiv-2404-16367.title: Learning Syntax Without Planting Trees: Understanding Hierarchical Generalization in Transformers
arxiv-2404-16367.creator: Kabir Ahuja, Vidhisha Balachandran, Madhur Panwar, Tianxing He, Noah A. Smith, Navin Goyal, Yulia Tsvetkov, University of Washington
arxiv-2404-16367.description: Abstract Transformers trained on natural language data have been shown to exhibit hierarchical generalization without explicitly encoding any structural bias. In this work, we investigate sources of inductive bias in transformer models and their training that could cause such preference for hierarchical generalization.

arxiv-2406-01840.title: Hybrid Maximal Filter Spaces
arxiv-2406-01840.creator: David Gonzalez
arxiv-2406-01840.description: Abstract . We introduce a new way of encoding general topology in second order arithmetic that we call hybrid maximal filter (hybrid MF) spaces. This notion is a modification of the notion of a proper MF space introduced by Montalbán.

arxiv-2502-05306.title: Dagger-Drazin Inverses
arxiv-2502-05306.creator: Robin Cockett, Jean-Simon Pacaud Lemay, Priyaa Varshinee Srinivasan
arxiv-2502-05306.description: Abstract Drazin inverses are a special kind of generalized inverses that can be defined for endomorphisms in any category. A natural question to ask is whether one can somehow extend the notion of Drazin inverse to arbitrary maps – not simply endomorphisms. It turns out that this is possible and, indeed, natural to do so for dagger categories.

arxiv-2503-05509.title: Practical Federated Learning without a Server Conference: The 5th Workshop on Machine Learning and Systems ; March 30-April 3 2025; Rotterdam, Netherlands The 5th Workshop on Machine Learning and Systems (EuroMLSys ’25), March 30-April 3 2025, Rotterdam, Netherlands DOI: 10.1145/3721146.3721938 ISBN
arxiv-2503-05509.creator: Akash Dhasade, Anne-Marie Kermarrec, Erick Lavoie, Johan Pouwelse, Rishi Sharma, Martijn de Vos
arxiv-2503-05509.description: Abstract . Federated Learning (FL) enables end-user devices to collaboratively train ML models without sharing raw data, thereby preserving data privacy. In FL, a central parameter server coordinates the learning process by iteratively aggregating the trained models received from clients. Yet, deploying a central server is not always feasible due to hardware unavailability, infrastructure constraints, or operational costs.

arxiv-2509-01499.title: When Do Consumers Lose from Variable Electricity Pricing? Journal: Energy Policy
arxiv-2509-01499.creator: Nathan Engelman Lado, Richard Chen, Saurabh Amin
arxiv-2509-01499.description: Abstract Time-varying electricity pricing better reflects the varying cost of electricity compared to flat-rate pricing. Variations between peak and off-peak costs are increasing due to weather variation, renewable intermittency, and increasing electrification of demand. Empirical and theoretical studies suggest that variable pricing can lower electricity supply costs and reduce grid stress.

arxiv-2512-01882.title: New Spiking Architecture for Multi-Modal Decision-Making in Autonomous Vehicles
arxiv-2512-01882.creator: Aref Ghoreishee, Abhishek Mishra, Lifeng Zhou, John Walsh, Nagarajan Kandasamy
arxiv-2512-01882.description: Abstract This work proposes an end-to-end multi-modal reinforcement learning framework for high-level decision-making in autonomous vehicles. The framework integrates heterogeneous sensory input, including camera images, LiDAR point clouds, and vehicle heading information, through a cross-attention transformer-based perception module. Although transformers have become the backbone of modern multi-modal architectures, their high computational cost limits their deployment in resource-constrained edge environments.

pmc-10632460.title: Modeling and efficiency analysis of blockchain agriculture products E-commerce cold chain traceability system based on Petri net
pmc-10632460.creator: Shouchen Liu, Zhaoyu Yu
pmc-10632460.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The cold chain supply chain of e-commerce has the characteristics of long chain, dispersed production, heterogeneous information sources, etc., which is easy to cause the upstream and downstream information of the supply chain to be broken and opaque. Traditional traceability data is stored in each node enterprise, and there are problems such as low cooperation trust and poor authenticity in the upstream and downstream data transmission process of the supply chain, resulting in consumers' trust crisis on the authenticity of traceability information.

pmc-12440762.title: Efficacy and health economics of Bufei Yishen granules in patients with frequent exacerbator phenotype in the stable phase of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: study protocol for a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
pmc-12440762.creator: Qionghua Xiao, Minghang Wang, Zegeng Li, Tao Chen, Jiansheng Li
pmc-12440762.description: IntroductionPatients with frequent exacerbator phenotype in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) tend to experience a progressive decline in lung function, a gradual deterioration of the disease, and even a serious threat to their lives. However, current treatment measures still need further improvements to reduce the frequency of acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD).

pmc-12470501.title: Evaluating the Neuroprotective Effects of Levetiracetam on Experimental Sciatic Nerve Injury
pmc-12470501.creator: Duygu Demiriz Gulmez, Gulay Hacioglu, Esma Cinar, Arif Keskin, Ozgun Cuvas Apan, Alparslan Apan, Hubertus Axer
pmc-12470501.description: Background/Objectives: Despite surgical interventions, patients experience incomplete nerve function recovery following peripheral nerve (PN) injuries. Levetiracetam (LEV), a third-generation antiepileptic agent and neuromodulator, has shown neuroprotective effects in conditions such as traumatic brain injury and diabetic neuropathy. However, its efficacy in PN injuries remains unexplored. Methods: We conducted an experimental study using 48 rats divided into six groups.

pmc-12666193.title: Long-term outcomes of JIA-associated uveitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12666193.creator: Laura Scagnellato, Giacomo Cozzi, Mariagrazia Lorenzin, Gianluca Poncina, Stefano Rizzetto, Roberta Ramonda
pmc-12666193.description: Background and aimJuvenile idiopathic arthritis-associated uveitis (JIAU) is a potentially blinding condition beginning in childhood. Flare-ups may occur throughout life, leading to cumulative ocular damage. This systematic review aimed to summarise the latest evidence on long-term ocular damage in adults with JIAU, focusing on studies published in the past 20 years.MethodsThe review protocol was registered in PROSPERO (ID 1033522).

pmc-13135607.title: L-glutamine-functionalized magnetic polystyrene for highly efficient synthesis of 2-amino-4H-pyrans
pmc-13135607.creator: Fatemeh Zahra Hajian, Sakineh Asghari, Ghasem Firouzzadeh Pasha, Taraneh Abbaspour, Mahmood Tajbakhsh, Fatemeh Zare
pmc-13135607.description: In this study, we reported the synthesis and characterization of a novel magnetic polystyrene nanocatalyst functionalized with L-glutamine (L-Glu-MPS) and evaluation of its catalytic performance in a multicomponent organic reaction for the preparation of 2-amino-4 H-pyrans. The catalyst was prepared through magnetization of chloromethylated polystyrene (PS-Cl) using FeCl2·4H2O and FeCl3·6H2O, followed by covalent attachment of L-glutamine.

pmc-13269456.title: Translation and Adaptation of the Online Gambling Disorder Questionnaire (OGD-Q) into Brazilian Portuguese
pmc-13269456.creator: Maria Clara Siqueira Rego, Victor Hugo Maia de Souza, Leonardo Fernandes Martins, Breno Sanvicente-Vieira
pmc-13269456.description: Online gambling has grown increasingly popular over the past decade, especially since the COVID-19 pandemic. Online gamblers tend to face more issues than those who gamble in traditional settings, leading to a higher risk of developing pathological gambling. In Brazil, gambling activities are culturally accepted and normalized, which encourages widespread participation among the population.

pmc-13478184.title: Synergistic corrosion protection and bacterial control in a UV-cured UA coating containing TiO2–polyaniline–calixarene nanocomposite
pmc-13478184.creator: Shakiba Dadkhah, Ali Gharieh, Fatemeh Rafimanzelat
pmc-13478184.description: An innovative nanocomposite architecture—TiO2–polyaniline‑doped sulfonated calixarene‑GMA (TiO2–PA–GSC)—is engineered for integration into UV‑curable waterborne urethane‑acrylate coatings. This design delivers concurrent improvements in cross‑link density, thermal stability (ΔT₅₀% = +31 °C), and electrochemical barrier properties with low‑frequency impedance rising by up to two orders of magnitude during long‑term immersion.

pmc-13683391.title: Deep Ocean Temperature from the Stratus Ocean Reference Station (85 °W, 20 °S), 2012–2025
pmc-13683391.creator: Yu Gao, Albert Plueddemann, Robert A Weller, Sebastien Bigorre
pmc-13683391.description: Long-term deep ocean temperature monitoring is crucial for understanding the ocean’s role in climate variability and storage of heat in the deep ocean. Observation of the ocean surface is relatively accessible via both in-situ and remote sensing; however, continuous, high-temporal resolution, decade-long temperature records from abyssal depths face the technical challenges of sustained deep ocean deployments.
